items.title: Preserve Python operation-group casing for traffic-filter methods
items.summary: The compatibility customizations exclude Python from the existing client-location rules for listAssociatedTrafficFilters and createAndAssociateIPFilter, then add Python-specific placements under PascalCase operation-group names.

inferenceResults.rationale: The Python-specific client locations preserve the released PascalCase operation-group placement; no breaking move is inferred.

items.title: Preserve Python operation-group casing for PL-filter creation
items.summary: The compatibility customization excludes Python from the existing createAndAssociatePLFilter client-location rule and adds a Python-specific placement under the PascalCase CreateAndAssociatePLFilter operation-group name.

inferenceResults.rationale: The Python-specific client locations preserve the released PascalCase operation-group placement; no breaking move is inferred.
